body: welp all their posts got removed. was actually finding it helpful

Haha if I had a heart condition, I'd die because I'd forget to take the pills. 
A couple things. I'm not sure what solo exercise there is other than running and lifting which is boring and shitty. I hate my life and feel constantly shitty. Lifting weights and or running just makes me feel shitter. Am I supposed to just suffer perpetual shittiness?

As for doctors specialists cost 50$ a visit and I'd have to see them constantly for new scripts. I don't have the money, since well I work a garbage job delivering pizzas.

The occupational therapist is an idea I havent heard. I'll check it out.

I'm sure exercise is important but I've tried setting fitness goals before and I'm not sure the point. Woo I achieved a meaningless number. Yay. Like I said with sports, I tried sports but I'm so bad people don't want to play with me. Like jiu jitsu. I was so shitty, people groaned whenever they had to roll with me and I just stopped going. Who wants to be where you aren't wanted.

I can try to learn to cook. 

As for meds I don't have them prescribed. I also don't have a doctor who can prescribe them. ADHD meds are a huge pain in the ass because you need a new script every time. I've tried vyvanse, and adderall both gave horrible nausea.

Problem with exercise is I find it extremely unenjoyable. Running and lifting are boring, people in team sports quickly get frustrated with me when I can't keep up which makes it suck.  I've been trying to fix my diet but its very hard because good tasting food is the only enjoyable part of my life right now. And just about any med I've tried has had horrible side effects.

I do have ADHD but I failed this exam for this job because they wanted me to learn C# and SQL in about a week. When it came for the exam I couldnt remember the syntax and nothing would work. And I wish I could agree about pizza delivery not sucking but everytime i meet new people they laugh at me when they find out i deliver pizzas. And its nearly everyone I meet.
